text:
Su Yin Lee
Sister in Charge
Hampstead Rehabilitation Center
695 Hampstead Road
Greenacres 
5029

12/12/2017

Dear Su Yin Lee,

Re: Shannon Wame, a 23-year-old third year university student
I am writing to refer Shannon into your care who has been treated for a severe car accident injury with probable permanent neurological damage, and requires a continuous rehabilitative care after his discharge.
Shannon has been hospitalized for about three months for his broken neck and pelvis fracture resulting from a car accident. He has made good progress. His bed sores were improved as his mobility has gradually increased; he has recently started using a wheelchair. Despite this, he will require high level of care sometimes.
Shannon’s mobility, speech, and memory might be affected due to the permanent neurological damage, for which he requires a range of therapy every week, including physiotherapy, hydrotherapy and speech therapy. In addition, he takes Nurofen for his frequent headache. For your information, he is eligible for disability pension, and his parents are keen to care for him.
Shannon will require your assistance to overcome his depression that developed after the accident. Would you please assist him to engage in activities and interests that he enjoys, as well as get him in touch with people at similar age as him via possible community access? Also, please follow up if he could continue his studies externally during his recovery.
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
RN
215 W
